summary: arXiv:2611.18600v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety evaluation in large language models treats harm as culturally invariant, yet a model cannot correctly apply a safety norm without knowing whose norms bind. We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension.
takeaways: We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension.
